editionLabel: English HABA rules, 29-animal base game for two to four players
firstPlayerRule: The person who can balance on one foot like a flamingo for the longest time starts.
officialTieBreak: If the group cannot agree, the youngest player starts by rolling the die.
clarifications: This answer is for the 29-animal base game. HABA's smaller two-player Animal Upon Animal: Small and Yet Great! has a different opening instruction.
evidenceNotes: HABA USA's linked English manual describes 29 animals and two to four players. The separate HABA instructions-hub file titled Small and yet great! has 13 animals and was not used as evidence for the base game.

firstPlayerRule: The person who owns the warmest winter hat starts by rolling the die.
clarifications: The instruction concerns a hat the player owns; it does not require wearing it at the table.

aliases: My Very First Games: First Orchard
editionLabel: English HABA My Very First Games rules
firstPlayerRule: Whoever ate an apple most recently takes the first turn.
officialTieBreak: If the group cannot agree, the youngest child starts by rolling the die.
clarifications: This is the first die roll in a cooperative game; players then take turns clockwise.

firstPlayerRule: The person who did a good deed most recently starts building.
officialTieBreak: If the players cannot agree, the youngest player starts.
clarifications: This is the base game's instruction; Rhino Hero: Super Battle uses a different criterion.

firstPlayerRule: The best climber takes the first turn.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise. The rulebook does not prescribe a climbing contest to determine who is best.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever saw a rainbow most recently starts by rolling the blue cloud die.

editionLabel: English HABA rules, eight-page publisher booklet
firstPlayerRule: The player who can jump the highest makes the first die roll.

editionLabel: English HABA USA rules, November 2019 file
firstPlayerRule: The player with the shaggiest hair starts and receives the fire marker.
clarifications: The fire marker stays with that player for the whole game.
